## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the component it affects.

## Hardware validation

- [ ] Standalone NRO built successfully, if affected
- [ ] Overlay/background package built successfully, if affected
- [ ] Tested on real Switch hardware
- [ ] Controller navigation and B-button escape behavior checked
- [ ] N64 Nintendo Switch Online compatibility considered for service/resource changes

## Safety and licensing

- [ ] No credentials, settings, session state, logs, crash reports, or binaries are included
- [ ] New third-party code retains its license and is documented in the notices
- [ ] The matching private ELF was retained for any hardware-tested binary
